goal: Repair the active equipment-detail public payload so a Manifest Catalog v2 verified BrowseVariant presents its verified static attributes, a readable source, and user-safe diagnostic text.
userValue: When a player opens an equipment candidate, they can see the attributes and source that the active catalog has verified; incomplete evidence remains honestly marked without exposing internal English diagnostics.
nonGoals: Do not rebuild or switch the active Catalog/Gear Release/Manifest revision, ingest new Battle.net data, or alter resolver, SimC, TemplateSet, PostgreSQL schema, or persisted player data.
Do not make Taro infer item attributes, source identity, or evidence status from opaque keys; the backend public projection remains authoritative.
Do not deploy, run sync/backfill, claim candidate/live verification, or claim WeChat manual acceptance in this local implementation phase.

currentTruth.factOwner: Manifest Catalog v2 owns verified BrowseVariant static facts and provenance; gear release/read-model serializers publish those facts; Taro consumes the public contract without inventing identity or trust.

mustChange: The Manifest Catalog v2 release adapter must project verified static facts as the public itemStats/stats contract with explicit catalog evidence provenance.

The release adapter must publish a readable, identity-matched source label when available and a safe source-type/difficulty fallback when it is not; opaque source keys cannot become player-facing labels.
The PG read-model selector and WebSim public normalizer must preserve the catalog evidence identity so verified Manifest facts do not incorrectly require Battle.net-only diagnostics.
Every public gear candidate diagnostic must be user-safe Chinese text; internal provider and implementation messages must not reach the detail view.
Targeted backend regressions must freeze the Manifest static-fact, source-label, trust, and diagnostic-sanitization contracts.
mustNotChange: Do not change active catalog pointers, resolver selection, exact-instance recovery, SimC compilation, source ingestion, timer state, or persisted data.
Do not relax the fail-closed behavior for an actually missing verified fact; it remains a blocked/partial diagnostic with safe user-facing text.
Do not add a frontend fallback, route-private UI patch, or a fabricated named drop source.
riskUnknown: The active source snapshot may omit an exact source label for a verified BrowseVariant; the fallback must remain informative without claiming an unverified encounter name.

Legacy public candidates can still carry internal diagnostic strings from non-Manifest paths; output sanitization must cover top-level and variant diagnostics without changing internal resolver diagnostics.
Candidate runtime caches and the active WeChat bundle still require immutable candidate smoke and explicit manual acceptance before merge.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN targeted Python regressions for Manifest static facts, exact source-label identity matching, verified catalog trust, and public diagnostic sanitization.
Focused release-store/read-model/cache and WebSim payload suites, Harness requirement validation, diff review, and local CR tied to this packet.
Before merge: immutable candidate-head API/read-model smoke proving a verified BrowseVariant returns readable source and stats, plus the explicit WeChat manual acceptance items below.

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_release_store.py publishes Manifest Catalog v2 BrowseVariant evidence; server/pg_gear_read_model_selectors.py and server/websim_payload.py preserve and safely normalize it; apps/mini-taro/src/pages/builds/gear-detail-model.ts renders the returned public fields.

engineeringHealth.reason: A user-visible public-payload regression crossed the Manifest adapter, PG read model, WebSim normalizer, and active detail consumer. The repair keeps one backend-owned evidence contract, uses TDD at each seam, and retains candidate/manual-acceptance gates.

acceptanceEvidence: A verified Manifest Catalog v2 item detail shows its verified static attributes instead of a blanket 待核验 state.
A verified item source is a readable exact source label when an identity-matched snapshot record exists, otherwise a truthful source-type/difficulty fallback; no opaque key is shown as a name.
A verified Manifest Catalog v2 item no longer displays Battle.net-only diagnostics merely because its evidence source is the active Manifest Catalog.
Any still-blocked public candidate displays safe Chinese diagnostics and does not expose internal provider/implementation text.
No active pointer, catalog revision, source ingestion, persisted data, remote runtime state, or UI geometry changes.

decisionLog.decision: The user approved implementation after the active WebSim payload demonstrated that verified Manifest static facts were dropped, sourceLabel was blank, and internal diagnostics reached the gear detail view.
The repair keeps Manifest Catalog v2 as a valid verified provenance source and does not fabricate Battle.net verification, encounter names, frontend-derived identity, or a catalog rebuild.
